info.title: OpenCrane Control Plane API
info.description:
Multi-tenant AI agent platform management API.

**Authentication**

- *Human operators* — OIDC browser flow via `GET /auth/login` → `/auth/callback`. Session cookie is set server-side.
- In-cluster workloads use short-lived, audience-bound projected service-account tokens at their dedicated internal trust boundaries.
- Endpoints tagged *Auth* and *Meta* (`/auth/*`, `/openapi.json`) require no credentials.

issues.description: Field diagnostics returned only for public request validation failures.

location.description: Request coordinate that contains the invalid field.

path.description: Field path segments suitable for direct form-control mapping.

message.description: Safe validation message that never includes the rejected value.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Absent when hasMore is false.

parentId.description: Parent group identifier, or null for a hierarchy root.

McpCatalogServer.description: An MCP server exposed by the operator API. Display metadata is optional because this shape serves both the entitled catalogue and the organisation-admin governance view; tools is always present and empty when no Ready OCI revision exists.

name.description: Display name shown in the catalogue.

description.description: Short summary shown to callers deciding whether to install the server.

publisher.description: Organisation or author label for the server.

glyph.description: Frontend icon key for the server.

type.description: How the server is configured for connection: single-user requires a caller-owned credential through an external custody flow, multi-user uses an administrator-managed shared key, and remote-oauth requires an OAuth handshake outside this API.

approvalStatus.description: Organisation-admin review state. Only published servers appear in the user-facing catalogue; approved servers remain hidden until publication.

credentialSchema.description: Input fields required by an external custody flow for a single-user connection. This API describes requested values but neither receives nor returns credential material.

entitlementSummary.description: Human-readable summary of access grants, returned for the governance view.

tools.description: Tools from the newest Ready OCI server revision. User catalogue rows are entitlement-filtered; administrator visibility never grants execution permission.

McpAssignableToolRevision.description: An immutable OCI-backed MCP tool schema selected from the newest Ready server revision. Governance eligibility does not replace caller authorization.

toolRevisionId.description: Immutable tool revision identifier saved during discovery.

serverRevisionId.description: Newest Ready server revision selected for this response.

name.description: Tool name reported by the MCP server.

description.description: Tool description reported by the MCP server, or null when it supplied none.

inputSchema.description: Input JSON Schema frozen during discovery.

inputSchemaDigest.description: Digest that binds assignment and run admission to this input schema.

eligibility.description: Whether Published and Active server governance permits assignment. It does not grant caller authority.

readiness.description: Discovery state that made the immutable schema available.

CredentialField.description: One input an external custody flow requires to connect a single-user MCP server. This API describes the input but neither receives nor returns its value.

key.description: Stable submission key for the value.

required.description: Whether a caller must supply this value to connect.

sensitive.description: Whether the client must treat the value as a secret, including masking it and never echoing it.

placeholder.description: Optional example or placeholder shown in the input.

hint.description: Optional help text shown below the input.

McpInstalled.description: An MCP server installed by the calling user, with its current connection state.

connectionStatus.description: Recorded activation requirement: needs-credential requires an external custody flow, while shared-key records an administrator-managed shared key. This API does not activate either state.

lastUsed.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the server's last use, or null when it has never been used.

EntitledUser.description: A local principal displayed in the MCP access editor or its selectable directory.

id.description: Stable local Principal identifier used by authorization grants.

name.description: Display name shown in the access editor.

initials.description: Initials derived from the display name for an avatar.

color.description: Deterministic avatar colour derived from the identifier.

EntitledGroup.description: A local group that can receive an MCP authorization grant.

id.description: Stable local Group identifier used by authorization grants.

name.description: Display name shown in the access editor. Authorization uses the identifier, not this value.

McpAccessPolicy.description: The user and group grants managed by the MCP access editor for one server. It does not list authorization grants managed by other sources.

groups.description: Groups with an active allow grant managed by the MCP access editor.

users.description: Principals with an active allow grant managed by the MCP access editor.

McpDirectory.description: The users and groups that an organisation administrator can select when editing MCP access.

users.description: All local principals eligible to receive an MCP authorization grant.

groups.description: All local groups eligible to receive an MCP authorization grant.

OciImageValidationSubmission.description: An organisation-admin request to admit one exact published OCI image. The idempotency key makes a retried request return the same saved record.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-chosen key that safely retries this submission.

artifactId.description: Published artifact identifier in the caller's silo.

artifactRevisionId.description: Exact immutable published revision to verify.

OciImageValidation.description: Saved status of one OCI image admission. A background workflow checks the full layout and imports every referenced blob into the configured registry.

artifactId.description: Published artifact identifier selected at submission.

artifactRevisionId.description: Immutable artifact revision selected at submission.

byteLength.description: Saved compressed bundle size in bytes.

mediaType.description: Media type saved with the artifact revision.

submissionDigest.description: Digest that binds the background job to its immutable input.

indexDigest.description: Digest of the verified OCI layout index, or null until verification succeeds.

imageManifestDigest.description: Digest of the selected OCI image manifest, or null until verification succeeds.

configDigest.description: Digest of the selected OCI image configuration, or null until verification succeeds.

registryReference.description: Digest-pinned image reference in the configured registry, or null until import succeeds.

failureCode.description: Bounded rejection reason, or null while pending or imported.

McpTaskInputRequest.description: One saved question that must be answered before the MCP tool may run.

requestId.description: Stable request identifier repeated by the response.

message.description: Plain-language question shown to the caller.

argumentName.description: Top-level tool argument filled by the accepted response.

McpTaskInputResponse.description: One caller response bound to the exact saved input request.

requestId.description: Identifier of the saved request being answered.

value.description: JSON value inserted into the exact top-level tool argument.

McpTaskSubmission.description: One idempotent asynchronous call of a discovered tool on an installed OCI-backed MCP server.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller key that makes retries select the same durable task.

serverRevisionId.description: Exact Ready MCP server revision selected from the installed catalogue.

toolRevisionId.description: Exact discovered tool revision on the selected server revision.

arguments.description: Tool arguments checked against the discovered immutable JSON Schema before execution.

McpTask.description: Caller-visible durable state for one OCI-backed MCP tool call. Arguments, workflow receipts, and executor identifiers are never returned.

toolName.description: Tool name frozen during MCP discovery.

protocolVersion.description: Only MCP protocol version accepted by the runtime.

state.description: Durable task state visible across process restarts.

inputRequest.description: Saved question still associated with the task, or null.

inputResponse.description: Accepted response, or null before the caller answers.

result.description: Checked MCP result after success, otherwise null.

failureCode.description: Bounded machine-readable failure or recovery code.

ResourceShare.description: A direct file, chat, or dataset share. Each recipient relation is backed by an explicit authorization grant.

resourceId.description: Identifier of the governed resource within its family.

get.summary: Read one participant-input request
get.description: Returns the browser-safe request only to its active assigned participant. Protected purpose payloads, dataset identifiers, credentials, and resume material are never returned.

post.summary: Answer one participant-input request
post.description: Submits one typed, idempotent answer. The server derives the actor, run, participant, purpose strategy, protected payload, and any verified step-up evidence.

400.description: The response does not match the exact request body.

401.description: No authenticated browser session owns the request.

post.summary: Queue one signed-in owner's instruction for a running agent
post.description: The server derives the owner, silo, and current attempt. The instruction is queued durably and exact retries reuse the same client key before consumption at the runtime's fenced safe boundary.

401.description: No authenticated browser session owns the request.

404.description: The run is absent or not owned by the caller.

409.description: The owned run has no steerable live attempt.

503.description: The product authority could not persist the instruction.
